The '''2012–13 Lehigh Mountain Hawks men's basketball team''' represented [[Lehigh University]] during the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Mountain Hawks, led by sixth year head coach [[Brett Reed (basketball)|Brett Reed]], played their home games at [[Stabler Arena]] and were members of the [[Patriot League]]. They finished the season 21–10, 10–4 in Patriot League play to finish in a tie for second play. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2013 Patriot League men's basketball tournament|Patriot League tournament]] where they lost to Lafayette. They were invited to the [[2013 College Basketball Invitational]] where they lost in the first round to Wyoming.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.mcall.com/2013/03/20/lehigh-loses-at-the-buzzer-to-wyoming-in-cbi/|title=Lehigh loses at the buzzer to Wyoming in CBI|work=[[The Morning Call]]|date=March 10, 2013|access-date=February 29, 2024}}</ref>
